answer: Clone-cost design: gate rewards on unique, peer-graded original work each epoch with on-ledger dedup (similarity > 0.85 rejected). Copying a prior answer or sibling template fails uniqueness, so a ripple of clones cannot share one write-up. Each fake must generate a fresh mechanism under the seed words, burning real model time and risking a failing grade that withholds jade emission while mirror standing stays locked for 3 epochs.
